scientific_contract.requirement: Structured Gaussian mixtures; one first-layer gradient step with fixed initialized second layer, then ridge-fit second layer on a NEW independent dataset. Do not silently train both layers jointly or reuse first-stage training data.

Proportional n/m/k regime; finite-rank-plus-identity, equal trace, zero component means in main result, scaled teacher direction, specified initialization and activation assumptions. Finite numerical observations are not asymptotic proof.

Hermite surrogate replaces activation AFTER original first-layer training; residual Gaussian term is part of surrogate, not optional truncation detail. Strict beta interval depends on degree; generalization theorem additionally needs A9. Beta=1 not covered by theorem4.

Source experiment n=m=k1000 for alpha sweep, beta=.74 in code, two equal-ratio rank-one Gaussian components, lambda1e-4, ReLU teacher, three activations.20 alpha values and20 feature repeats are source choices, not mandatory benchmark solver recipe.
